import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int num_rounds = Integer.parseInt(scanner.nextLine().trim());
        String[] p1_moves_str = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        String[] p2_moves_str = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        List<Integer> p1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> p2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String s : p1_moves_str) {
            p1.add(Integer.parseInt(s));
        }
        for (String s : p2_moves_str) {
            p2.add(Integer.parseInt(s));
        }
        calculate(num_rounds, p1, p2);
        scanner.close();
    }

    public static void calculate(int n, List<Integer> p1, List<Integer> p2) {
        int win_score = 0;
        List<Integer> p2_cycle = new ArrayList<>(p2);
        p2_cycle.add(p2.get(0));
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            win_score += Math.min(p1.get(i), p2_cycle.get(i + 1));
        }
        p2_cycle.remove(p2_cycle.size() - 1);
        p2.add(0, p2.get(2));
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (p1.get(i) > 0) {
                int min_move = Math.min(p1.get(i), p2.get(i));
                p1.set(i, p1.get(i) - min_move);
                p2.set(i, p2.get(i) - min_move);
                if (p1.get(i) > 0) {
                    int min_move2 = Math.min(p1.get(i), p2.get(i + 1));
                    p1.set(i, p1.get(i) - min_move2);
                    p2.set(i + 1, p2.get(i + 1) - min_move2);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(p1.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum() + " " + win_score);
    }
}
